description: Independently written factual metadata extracted for source-contract research; not a redistributed copy of the NWS schema or README.

schema_facts.authentication_declared: Identifying User-Agent header; no API-key scheme declared for these public operations.

operations.purpose: Discover forecast, hourly forecast, grid data, and observation-station URLs for a geographic point.
Discover official active alerts; supports geographic point filtering.
Retrieve latest available observation with measurement units, timestamp, and quality-control information.
Retrieve NWS forecast-grid values; preserve interval timestamps and units.
Discover available radar-station metadata; not a source of raw radar sweeps.

grid_contract.nominal_grid_description: 2.5 km grid square per schema description; does not establish terrain representativeness or exact point prediction.
grid_contract.coverage_rule: Potential schema layers may be absent in particular areas.

schema_facts.provenance_rule: NWS official forecast update/generation timestamps must not be presented as the initialization time of a named numerical model.
